Dialog.Adjusted: Transferring {value} HP (adjusted to the allowed range).
Dialog.ElementNote: If one or more of your elemental epiphanies are active, you must select the elemental trait you chose as part of casting those spells.
Dialog.ElementPrompt: Choose the elemental trait and damage type for the target's next Strike.
Dialog.MaximumAtLevel: Maximum you may transfer at level {level}: {max} HP
Dialog.SelfTarget: No token is targeted. Transfer vitality into {name} instead?

AdvancedOverrides.Hint: Optional JSON merged over the built-in values, for example {"transfer":{"progression":"houseRule"},"recharge":{"master":9}}. Unknown keys and code formulas are ignored.
AdvancedOverrides.Name: Advanced overrides (JSON)

CapacityCorrectOnStartup.Hint: Also correct every character as the world loads, rather than waiting for their turn or their first transfer.
CapacityCorrectOnStartup.Name: Correct the network maximum as the world loads

CapacityEnforce.Hint: Rewrite the Vitality Network item's SpecialResource formula when it disagrees with the printed rules. The archetype feat's own formula steps at 5th level and reaches 50, where its text steps at 10th, 15th and 20th and reaches 40.
CapacityEnforce.Name: Make the network maximum match the printed rules

Diagnostics.Hint: Check which characters have a vitality network, how their maxima compare with the printed rules, and which settings are in effect.
Diagnostics.Label: Vitality Network diagnostics
Diagnostics.Name: Diagnostics

ElementalDamageTypeOverride.Hint: Let Elemental Harmony change the damage type of the target's Strikes. PF2e cannot limit this to a single Strike, so it lasts until the effect expires.
ElementalDamageTypeOverride.Name: Elemental Harmony changes the damage type

HarmonyFallback.Hint: The harmony applied when the caster's mystic connection cannot be detected. Set to None to attach nothing.
HarmonyFallback.Name: Harmony when no connection is found

PostChatSummary.Name: Post a chat summary for each transfer

RechargeInCombatOnly.Hint: Only recharge the network at the start of a turn in combat, as the rules describe.
RechargeInCombatOnly.Name: Recharge only in combat

RefocusClassFeatureOnly.Hint: Strictly, the Refocus refill belongs to the mystic class feature. Turn this on to withhold it from characters who only have the archetype feat.
RefocusClassFeatureOnly.Name: Refocus refill for the class feature only

RefocusEnabled.Hint: Refill the vitality network when the character Refocuses, or when focus points are restored.
RefocusEnabled.Name: Refocus refills the network

RelayToGM.Hint: Let the GM's client apply the healing, the effects and the harmonies when a player cannot edit the target's character.
RelayToGM.Name: Ask the GM's client to apply target-side changes

SingleClientDialogs.Hint: Only the client that created the action's chat card shows the amount dialog.
SingleClientDialogs.Name: One client shows the dialog

SourceOverride.Hint: Use this if a copy has lost its source id and the module reads the wrong feature. It only reclassifies a network the character already has.
SourceOverride.Name: Which feature grants the network

TransferProgression.Hint: Which transfer maximum to use. 'Follow the item' uses the class feature's +10 steps for a mystic and the archetype feat's +5 steps for a multiclass character.
TransferProgression.Name: Transfer maximum progression
TransferProgression.Source: Follow the item the character has

VerboseLogging.Hint: Trace the module's decisions in the browser console.
VerboseLogging.Name: Verbose console logging
